# `adt capabilities`

Report installed runtime capabilities as versioned JSON (identity, formats, configured modules)

```bash
adt capabilities [options]
```

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
